# Adidas 3 Stripes Festival Ultimate Deals Guide

The Adidas 3 Stripes Festival is one of the biggest shopping events for sports and lifestyle enthusiasts. From November 6th to November 11th, 2026, get exclusive discounts on premium sportswear and footwear.

## Special Offers Overview

- **Direct Price Reductions**: Selected items already discounted
- **adiClub Member Exclusive**: Extra 5% off on orders $600+
- **VIP Benefits**: Extra 10% off on orders $1000+
